about: Every way the mashup touches the two games, and every engine system it runs. One row each; code lives in the module named in impl.

rows.source: launch arg --stellaris "{game}" (Melty passes it); fallback: Steam libraryfolders.vdf → steamapps/common/Stellaris
rows.method: path check for stellaris.exe or the common/ folder

rows.source: --stacklands arg, else Steam (registry SteamPath or default) libraryfolders.vdf → steamapps/common/Stacklands

rows.method: parse key:N "value" lines, strip $refs$ and §colour codes

rows.what: Species portraits for the empire pick
rows.method: collect every texturefile; group by folder (species class)
Pfim (DXT1/3/5, BC7, uncompressed) → RGBA → raylib texture; first frame of icon strips
AssetsTools.NET with the bundled class database; index Texture2D, Sprite, AudioClip, Font by name
AssetsTools.NET.Texture → BGRA → raylib texture; Sprite rect crop when the hit is a Sprite
Fmod5Sharp → OGG/WAV bytes → raylib LoadSoundFromWave / music stream
--probe writes probe.json: every sprite/texture/audio/font name and which asset_refs row each lookup resolved to

rows.what: Card simulation (stacks, timers, moons, combat, packs, acts)
